statement: Arm launched an AI Portal connecting more than 22 million developers to pre-optimized models across cloud, edge and physical AI, with Alibaba Qwen, Google Gemma and Ultralytics YOLO as launch content.
why: Developer tooling that makes models run well on non-GPU compute widens where inference workloads can be hosted.

impact.mechanism: Pre-optimized models and deployment tooling lower the switching cost of running inference on Arm-based CPUs and edge silicon instead of GPUs.

evidence.excerpt: Arm AI Portal connects more than 22 million developers and their agents to optimized AI software across the Arm compute platform spanning cloud, edge and physical AI.

confidence.basis: Vendor announcement page classified as secondary here; developer-count claim is self-reported and unaudited.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend unknown -> rising); sources: 247wallst.com, newsroom.arm.com
